response.overview: Watch stunning beauties from the hottest music videos on MTV groove to blazin’ beats from the best producers in hip-hop. Featuring 12 of the world’s most beautiful exotic models posing in intimate video segments, 'Hip-Hop Honeys: Blazin’ Asians' is a fast and furious ride with the most gorgeous Asian models on the planet. Party with the Game Girls as we take uncut music video to a whole new level! Also features behind-the-scenes footage, 'Honeys Uncut' music video and the DVD sampler. Hosted by DJ Lady Tribe!
